title_en: No dedicated leave-on BHA treatment under the SRICHAND brand
missing_category: BHA (salicylic acid) serum / toner with a disclosed strength
why_it_matters_en: Oil-soluble exfoliation is the highest-return step for shine, congestion and blackheads — the dominant concern in a hot, humid market and the heart of Srichand's oil-control heritage. Salicylic acid does exist in the portfolio — it is on the official INCI of 13 products (Sunlution Acne Care at #32 of 54, plus 12 SASI products led by the Acne Sol line) — but never as a SRICHAND-brand leave-on treatment and never with a stated percentage.
closest_in_range_limits_en: A SASI (sister-brand) pad with undisclosed BHA strength; fine for maintenance, may be too mild for established congestion.
generic_external_option_en: A 2% salicylic acid (BHA) leave-on liquid or toner from a pharmacy or drugstore, used 2–3 nights a week.
generic_external_option_th: ผลิตภัณฑ์ BHA (ซาลิไซลิก แอซิด) 2% แบบไม่ต้องล้างออก จากร้านขายยาหรือร้านเครื่องสำอางทั่วไป ใช้สัปดาห์ละ 2–3 คืน
commercial_read_en: Clearest white-space SKU: a 'Sunlution-grade' BHA serum or pad under SRICHAND IN-SKIN would sit directly on the brand's oil-control equity.

why_it_matters_en: Azelaic acid is the best-tolerated single answer for redness that coexists with post-blemish marks, and is usable where retinoids are not.
closest_in_range_limits_en: Covers the marks (tranexamic acid + niacinamide) but not the redness / bumps side.
generic_external_option_en: An azelaic acid 10% cream or gel from a pharmacy; above 10% is a medicine — ask a pharmacist.
generic_external_option_th: ครีมหรือเจลอะเซลาอิก แอซิด 10% จากร้านขายยา (ความเข้มข้นสูงกว่านี้จัดเป็นยา ควรปรึกษาเภสัชกร)
commercial_read_en: Natural partner to the Barrier Boost line for the 'sensitive but blemish-prone' customer.

title_en: Persistent or inflammatory acne needs medicine, not cosmetics
why_it_matters_en: Thai law classes acne treatment as a drug claim. For moderate-to-severe or scarring acne the honest answer is outside any cosmetic range.
closest_in_range_limits_en: Supports a routine for blemish-prone skin; does not treat acne.
generic_external_option_en: See a pharmacist or dermatologist about a topical acne medicine. Keep the routine around it gentle: Barrier Boost cleanser and gel cream, Sunlution Acne Care.
generic_external_option_th: แนะนำปรึกษาเภสัชกรหรือแพทย์ผิวหนังเรื่องยาทาสิว และดูแลผิวควบคู่ด้วยผลิตภัณฑ์ที่อ่อนโยน
commercial_read_en: Referral honesty builds the trust that sells the supporting routine (cleanser, barrier care, sunscreen).

why_it_matters_en: Frequently requested. Low clinical necessity, but matters for basket size and for under-eye concerns the advisor will detect in photos.
closest_in_range_limits_en: Covers under-eye darkness cosmetically; no treatment benefit.
generic_external_option_en: Any fragrance-free eye cream with caffeine or peptides; or simply tap your facial moisturiser around the orbital bone.
generic_external_option_th: อายครีมสูตรไม่มีน้ำหอมที่มีคาเฟอีนหรือเปปไทด์ หรือใช้มอยส์เจอร์ไรเซอร์แตะเบา ๆ รอบดวงตา
commercial_read_en: Easy line extension for Timeless or Phyto Camellia PDRN.

title_en: No body sunscreen or body care
why_it_matters_en: Face-only sun protection leaves neck, arms and hands exposed; customers ask for a matching body product.
closest_in_range_limits_en: Water-resistant and pleasant, but 40 ml is a face size — uneconomical for body.
generic_external_option_en: A body sunscreen SPF50+ PA++++ in a 100 ml+ size from any drugstore.
generic_external_option_th: กันแดดทาตัว SPF50+ PA++++ ขนาด 100 มล. ขึ้นไป จากร้านทั่วไป
commercial_read_en: Sunlution has the filter technology and brand permission to extend to body.
